title: Parity of the Absolute Value of a Cubic Function h(t) = |t^3|
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the function h(t) = |t^3| is even, odd, or neither, and justify your answer.

steps.title: Substitute -t into h(t)
steps.explanation: Replace t with -t inside the absolute value bars and simplify (-t)^3 = -t^3.
steps.why: Cubing a negated variable negates the cube: (-t)^3 = -t^3.

steps.title: Apply the Even Property of Absolute Value
steps.explanation: Because |-u| = |u| for every real number u, |-t^3| simplifies to |t^3|, which equals h(t).
steps.why: The absolute value of any quantity equals the absolute value of its negation.

steps.title: Conclude Function Parity
steps.explanation: Since h(-t) = h(t) for all real numbers t, h(t) = |t^3| is an even function.
steps.why: Taking the absolute value of an odd function always produces an even function.
